findings.summary: Pre-existing tests test_development.py, test_gate.py, and test_pump.py (plus test_ephemeral.py::test_ephemeral_routes_dd_writes_to_ephemeral_controller and test_backend_errors.py::test_backend_unavailable_controller_surfaces_as_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE) still invoke the now-retired ronin_dev_*/ronin_gate_*/ronin_pump_* tools, which build_mcp_server no longer registers, so a full-suite run goes red. This is the intended consequence of the spec-mandated source-level retirement combined with the '不删除/改写其它既有测试' red line; acceptance is correctly scoped to tests/test_m3_roninmcp_disposition.py, and the production-retirement execution order (wf-3ffd90) should reconcile those tests.
